fusions.name: Whipped Switch
fusions.desc: A flick of the tail that deals 4 damage to a target up to 4 tiles away, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snarled Line
fusions.desc: Strews a 4-tile line of snarled strands ahead of you for 5 seconds. It deals 7 damage to each enemy that crosses it and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Combed Out
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. Fighting beside others pays: +10% per ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Matted Hide
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
